description:
Refactor the 'banking-system' project to eliminate code duplication. The classes 'CheckingAccount' and 'SavingsAccount' have identical fields (accountNumber, balance, owner) and methods (deposit, withdraw). 

Your task:
1. Create a new abstract superclass named 'com.banking.BankAccount'.
2. Make both CheckingAccount and SavingsAccount extend this new superclass.
3. Move the common fields and methods up to BankAccount.
4. Ensure the application still compiles and tests pass.
